title: Flooded Village Search and Rescue
description: B-Roll of Ohio Task Force 1 performing water search and rescue operations at Muscatatuck Urban Training Center in Indiana during Vibrant Response 14. Vibrant Response is a major field training exercise conducted by the U.S. Northern Command and led by U.S. Army North. Approximately 5,000 service members and civilians from the military and other federal and state agencies throughout the country are training to respond to a catastrophic domestic incident. As a component of U.S. Northern Command, Army North coordinates timely federal and military response to disasters in the homeland to help the American people in a time of need.
